issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Round 3 of this training is the final test, and it only evaluates. Do not diagnose, make a candidate, put a worker back or change any worker: the delivered workers stay cand-g2's, as round 2 released them (tuner release/ at 1e2f008), and the release of this round is the evaluation record of the test with the delivered workers unchanged. Because no worker is put back in this round, the approval rests on this round's evaluation record and on the delivered files being round 2's cand-g2 files passing `worker check`.

The test paper is paper_35 (ICML 2025), which no earlier round could read. Its world is rw_243f5a8e723d at checkpoint c0, in the state root issue-319-test now given to you to read, and its writing material and verifier files are the test-material resource. Both belong to the position that keeps the held-out tasks and to the judge alone, as the held-out tasks do.

Three workers are tested, five runs each, fifteen runs in all, all at once: incumbent@v3 (a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-Workers incumbent@v3, for both positions), cand-a (a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-Workers cand-a-writer@v1 for paper-repo and cand-a-reviewer@v1 for internal-review-repo), and cand-g2 (the tuner's release/paper-repo.worker.json and release/internal-review-repo.worker.json at 1e2f008). Each run is a world continued from rw_243f5a8e723d at c0 with the full configuration of that world, only the workers of paper-repo and internal-review-repo changed, and worker.image set to sha256:9e1a5cf44254cd09d093183a146954ed2a26e2af1220d6042ae85bcc60ead6a4 (researchworld-worker:i319d) for every run (the image that world recorded no longer exists; all fifteen runs use this one), "resources": [] written out, budget.total_seconds 1800, at most 12 turns and 1800 model seconds.

Judging is unchanged: the benchmark's verifier (test-material's evaluate.py with paper_35's files: reward and every component) and rubric v2 (/initial-state/inputs/1/rubric-v2.md, sha256 5df317ee3a2b8b49d785f7f7b4195d1b5a49337f939cab25dde4ff0e720f1250) on every one of the fifteen manuscripts.

Comparison. With the labels published, report for each worker its rubric mean, min, max and spread (max minus min), each item's mean, and its verifier mean, min, max and each component. Then compare cand-g2 with incumbent@v3 and, separately, with cand-a: cand-g2 counts as better than a worker only if its rubric mean exceeds that worker's mean by more than that worker's spread and its verifier mean is not below that worker's. Report both results as they are; they change no worker. No pull request to HuTian-Workers in this round. This world ends at its wall-clock budget; have the release done well before it.

issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Round 2 of improving the paper-writing worker of rw_313df9cf84a4 (positions paper-repo and internal-review-repo). The model stays Claude Code claude-sonnet-5-5; only the workers' content and settings change.

Where round 1 ended. Round 1 compared cand-a with cand-g2 on the three held-out papers and kept cand-g2 (judge record and summary at judge 0bbced3..cafc01c: per-paper rubric difference 3.67 on average against cand-a's average within-paper spread 2.00; verifier 0.9268 against 0.9013). cand-g2 is now the incumbent: the tuner's release/paper-repo.worker.json and release/internal-review-repo.worker.json at 66c3813, shown from the put-back world rw_5ddd4a32628d. Round 1's judgements, label table and comparison are records of round 1: they count for nothing in this round, and no judgement of this round is made from them.

This round: diagnose cand-g2 from its runs on the diagnostic tasks (run it there first) and round 1's summary, make one candidate from the diagnosis, and compare cand-g2 with it on the three held-out papers. Runs of cand-g2 made in round 1 are not reused: both workers run anew in this round, from each paper's c0.

Tasks. A task is one PaperWrite-Bench paper written by the two positions in a world continued from that paper's world at checkpoint c0, with the full configuration of that world, only the workers of paper-repo and internal-review-repo changed, "resources": [] written out, budget.total_seconds 1800, at most 12 turns and 1800 model seconds.
- Diagnostic tasks: paper_29 (rw_313df9cf84a4 at c0), paper_36 (rw_06110020973f at c0) and paper_11 (rw_68232c8e31e5 at c0). The verifier and its files for these papers are in /initial-state/inputs/0 (its README says how to run it).
- Held-out tasks: paper_39 (rw_19be25bd2f7d at c0), paper_8 (rw_63a9955aa418 at c0) and paper_26 (rw_eb48fe4d5256 at c0). Their writing material and verifier files are the heldout-material resource. paper_35 is in no world given to you and is not a task.
The held-out worlds (and every world made from them), the heldout-material resource, the held-out manuscripts and their judgements belong to the position that keeps the held-out tasks and to the judge; the positions that diagnose and change the worker read the judge's summary after the decision, never a held-out manuscript.

Judging. Every held-out manuscript gets both: the benchmark's verifier (evaluate.py, as its README says: reward and every component; it measures form, section names, length and citation coverage, not the writing), and rubric v2 (/initial-state/inputs/1/rubric-v2.md, sha256 5df317ee3a2b8b49d785f7f7b4195d1b5a49337f939cab25dde4ff0e720f1250: 12 items scored 0-4, total 0-48, written for any PaperWrite-Bench paper). Neither changes during this world.

Comparison and rule. This round compares the incumbent cand-g2 and one candidate on the three held-out papers, three runs of each worker per paper (18 manuscripts). For each paper take the candidate's rubric mean minus the incumbent's, and average over the three papers. The candidate is kept only if that average is larger than the average of the incumbent's spread within each paper (max minus min of its rubric totals on that paper), and the candidate's verifier mean over its nine runs is not below the incumbent's. Otherwise the incumbent stays.

Then the position that puts the kept worker back continues rw_313df9cf84a4 from its newest checkpoint with the kept worker and runs that round; the tuner writes the kept worker's two worker.json files with `worker show` from that put-back world, passing `worker check`, with what changed (a kept incumbent keeps its version). No pull request to HuTian-Workers in this round. This world ends at its wall-clock budget; have the release done well before it.

issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Improve the paper-writing worker of the research world rw_313df9cf84a4: the workers of its positions paper-repo and internal-review-repo, which together write a paper from a PaperWrite-Bench task. The model stays Claude Code claude-sonnet-5-5; only the workers' content and settings change. This is the first round of this world.

The incumbent is cand-a: a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-Workers cand-a-writer@v1 for paper-repo and cand-a-reviewer@v1 for internal-review-repo. Earlier training in other worlds kept cand-a against three candidates, by the verifier means of their held-out runs on paper_39: cand-c and cand-d (a five-step writing process with mechanical checks, 0.750 against 0.905), cand-e (cand-a plus a three-command finish gate, 0.879 against 0.888), cand-f (effort medium, a short frame per table and a page count measured with pdfinfo, 0.917 against 0.907, not shown better by a reading). Only these verifier results are given; no reading of those manuscripts counts.

Tasks. A task is one PaperWrite-Bench paper written by the two positions in a world continued from that paper's world at checkpoint c0, with the full configuration of that world, only the workers of paper-repo and internal-review-repo changed, "resources": [] written out, budget.total_seconds 1800, at most 12 turns and 1800 model seconds.
- Diagnostic tasks: paper_29 (rw_313df9cf84a4 at c0), paper_36 (rw_06110020973f at c0) and paper_11 (rw_68232c8e31e5 at c0). The verifier and its files for these papers are in /initial-state/inputs/0 (its README says how to run it).
- Held-out tasks: paper_39 (rw_19be25bd2f7d at c0), paper_8 (rw_63a9955aa418 at c0) and paper_26 (rw_eb48fe4d5256 at c0). Their writing material and verifier files are the heldout-material resource. paper_35 is in no world given to you and is not a task.
The held-out worlds (and every world made from them), the heldout-material resource, the held-out manuscripts and their judgements belong to the position that keeps the held-out tasks and to the judge; the positions that diagnose and change the worker read the judge's summary after the decision, never a held-out manuscript.

Judging. Every held-out manuscript gets both: the benchmark's verifier (evaluate.py, as its README says: reward and every component; it measures form, section names, length and citation coverage, not the writing), and rubric v2 (/initial-state/inputs/1/rubric-v2.md, sha256 5df317ee3a2b8b49d785f7f7b4195d1b5a49337f939cab25dde4ff0e720f1250: 12 items scored 0-4, total 0-48, written for any PaperWrite-Bench paper). Neither changes during this world.

Comparison and rule. This round compares the incumbent and one candidate on the three held-out papers, three runs of each worker per paper (18 manuscripts). For each paper take the candidate's rubric mean minus the incumbent's, and average over the three papers. The candidate is kept only if that average is larger than the average of the incumbent's spread within each paper (max minus min of its rubric totals on that paper), and the candidate's verifier mean over its nine runs is not below the incumbent's. Otherwise the incumbent stays.

Then the position that puts the kept worker back continues rw_313df9cf84a4 from its newest checkpoint with the kept worker and runs that round; the tuner writes the kept worker's two worker.json files with `worker show` from that put-back world, passing `worker check`, with what changed (a kept incumbent keeps its version). No pull request to HuTian-Workers in this round. This world ends at its wall-clock budget; have the release done well before it.

issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Round 3 of this training is the final test, and it only evaluates. Do not diagnose, make a candidate, put a worker back or change any worker: the delivered workers stay cand-g2's, as round 2 released them (tuner release/ at 1e2f008), and the release of this round is the evaluation record of the test with the delivered workers unchanged. Because no worker is put back in this round, the approval rests on this round's evaluation record and on the delivered files being round 2's cand-g2 files passing `worker check`.

issue.title: Improvement objective

issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Round 2 of improving the paper-writing worker of rw_313df9cf84a4 (positions paper-repo and internal-review-repo). The model stays Claude Code claude-sonnet-5-5; only the workers' content and settings change.

Where round 1 ended. Round 1 compared cand-a with cand-g2 on the three held-out papers and kept cand-g2 (judge record and summary at judge 0bbced3..cafc01c: per-paper rubric difference 3.67 on average against cand-a's average within-paper spread 2.00; verifier 0.9268 against 0.9013). cand-g2 is now the incumbent: the tuner's release/paper-repo.worker.json and release/internal-review-repo.worker.json at 66c3813, shown from the put-back world rw_5ddd4a32628d. Round 1's judgements, label table and comparison are records of round 1: they count for nothing in this round, and no judgement of this round is made from them.

This round: diagnose cand-g2 from its runs on the diagnostic tasks (run it there first) and round 1's summary, make one candidate from the diagnosis, and compare cand-g2 with it on the three held-out papers. Runs of cand-g2 made in round 1 are not reused: both workers run anew in this round, from each paper's c0.

Tasks. A task is one PaperWrite-Bench paper written by the two positions in a world continued from that paper's world at checkpoint c0, with the full configuration of that world, only the workers of paper-repo and internal-review-repo changed, "resources": [] written out, budget.total_seconds 1800, at most 12 turns and 1800 model seconds.
- Diagnostic tasks: paper_29 (rw_313df9cf84a4 at c0), paper_36 (rw_06110020973f at c0) and paper_11 (rw_68232c8e31e5 at c0). The verifier and its files for these papers are in /initial-state/inputs/0 (its README says how to run it).
- Held-out tasks: paper_39 (rw_19be25bd2f7d at c0), paper_8 (rw_63a9955aa418 at c0) and paper_26 (rw_eb48fe4d5256 at c0). Their writing material and verifier files are the heldout-material resource. paper_35 is in no world given to you and is not a task.
The held-out worlds (and every world made from them), the heldout-material resource, the held-out manuscripts and their judgements belong to the position that keeps the held-out tasks and to the judge; the positions that diagnose and change the worker read the judge's summary after the decision, never a held-out manuscript.

Judging. Every held-out manuscript gets both: the benchmark's verifier (evaluate.py, as its README says: reward and every component; it measures form, section names, length and citation coverage, not the writing), and rubric v2 (/initial-state/inputs/1/rubric-v2.md, sha256 5df317ee3a2b8b49d785f7f7b4195d1b5a49337f939cab25dde4ff0e720f1250: 12 items scored 0-4, total 0-48, written for any PaperWrite-Bench paper). Neither changes during this world.

Comparison and rule. This round compares the incumbent cand-g2 and one candidate on the three held-out papers, three runs of each worker per paper (18 manuscripts). For each paper take the candidate's rubric mean minus the incumbent's, and average over the three papers. The candidate is kept only if that average is larger than the average of the incumbent's spread within each paper (max minus min of its rubric totals on that paper), and the candidate's verifier mean over its nine runs is not below the incumbent's. Otherwise the incumbent stays.

Then the position that puts the kept worker back continues rw_313df9cf84a4 from its newest checkpoint with the kept worker and runs that round; the tuner writes the kept worker's two worker.json files with `worker show` from that put-back world, passing `worker check`, with what changed (a kept incumbent keeps its version). No pull request to HuTian-Workers in this round. This world ends at its wall-clock budget; have the release done well before it.

issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Improve the paper-writing worker of the research world rw_313df9cf84a4: the workers of its positions paper-repo and internal-review-repo, which together write a paper from a PaperWrite-Bench task. The model stays Claude Code claude-sonnet-5-5; only the workers' content and settings change. This is the first round of this world.

The incumbent is cand-a: a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-Workers cand-a-writer@v1 for paper-repo and cand-a-reviewer@v1 for internal-review-repo. Earlier training in other worlds kept cand-a against three candidates, by the verifier means of their held-out runs on paper_39: cand-c and cand-d (a five-step writing process with mechanical checks, 0.750 against 0.905), cand-e (cand-a plus a three-command finish gate, 0.879 against 0.888), cand-f (effort medium, a short frame per table and a page count measured with pdfinfo, 0.917 against 0.907, not shown better by a reading). Only these verifier results are given; no reading of those manuscripts counts.

Tasks. A task is one PaperWrite-Bench paper written by the two positions in a world continued from that paper's world at checkpoint c0, with the full configuration of that world, only the workers of paper-repo and internal-review-repo changed, "resources": [] written out, budget.total_seconds 1800, at most 12 turns and 1800 model seconds.
- Diagnostic tasks: paper_29 (rw_313df9cf84a4 at c0), paper_36 (rw_06110020973f at c0) and paper_11 (rw_68232c8e31e5 at c0). The verifier and its files for these papers are in /initial-state/inputs/0 (its README says how to run it).
- Held-out tasks: paper_39 (rw_19be25bd2f7d at c0), paper_8 (rw_63a9955aa418 at c0) and paper_26 (rw_eb48fe4d5256 at c0). Their writing material and verifier files are the heldout-material resource. paper_35 is in no world given to you and is not a task.
The held-out worlds (and every world made from them), the heldout-material resource, the held-out manuscripts and their judgements belong to the position that keeps the held-out tasks and to the judge; the positions that diagnose and change the worker read the judge's summary after the decision, never a held-out manuscript.

Judging. Every held-out manuscript gets both: the benchmark's verifier (evaluate.py, as its README says: reward and every component; it measures form, section names, length and citation coverage, not the writing), and rubric v2 (/initial-state/inputs/1/rubric-v2.md, sha256 5df317ee3a2b8b49d785f7f7b4195d1b5a49337f939cab25dde4ff0e720f1250: 12 items scored 0-4, total 0-48, written for any PaperWrite-Bench paper). Neither changes during this world.

Comparison and rule. This round compares the incumbent and one candidate on the three held-out papers, three runs of each worker per paper (18 manuscripts). For each paper take the candidate's rubric mean minus the incumbent's, and average over the three papers. The candidate is kept only if that average is larger than the average of the incumbent's spread within each paper (max minus min of its rubric totals on that paper), and the candidate's verifier mean over its nine runs is not below the incumbent's. Otherwise the incumbent stays.

Then the position that puts the kept worker back continues rw_313df9cf84a4 from its newest checkpoint with the kept worker and runs that round; the tuner writes the kept worker's two worker.json files with `worker show` from that put-back world, passing `worker check`, with what changed (a kept incumbent keeps its version). No pull request to HuTian-Workers in this round. This world ends at its wall-clock budget; have the release done well before it.

The test paper is paper_35 (ICML 2025), which no earlier round could read. Its world is rw_243f5a8e723d at checkpoint c0, in the state root issue-319-test now given to you to read, and its writing material and verifier files are the test-material resource. Both belong to the position that keeps the held-out tasks and to the judge alone, as the held-out tasks do.

You score rubric v2 per label. Tell me here if you want another layout. Note: the worlds' incumbent label is 'incumbent v3' with differing commits (paper_29/39 534c23c9; others 2df1b7b5), not cand-a-writer@v1 - I'll run cand-a as the objective names it. I still need the candidate (tuner) before I can start the runs.

comments.author: judge
comments.body: The layout is acceptable. Keep each of the 18 results under an opaque random label and withhold the label table until all 18 individual judgements are pushed. For each label please include task/paper, repetition, world/run provenance, manuscript.tex and pdf, verifier output (reward plus every component), and a manifest tying files to the opaque label without worker identity. I will record rubric-v2 item scores and evidence per label in evaluation/ and push before requesting the mapping. The incumbent naming discrepancy is fine: use the objective's cand-a worker pair while preserving the actual world/config commits in provenance.

issue.body:
Improve the paper-writing worker of the research world rw_313df9cf84a4: the workers of its positions paper-repo and internal-review-repo, which together write a paper from a PaperWrite-Bench task. The model stays Claude Code claude-sonnet-5-5; only the workers' content and settings change. This is the first round of this world.

The incumbent is cand-a: a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-Workers cand-a-writer@v1 for paper-repo and cand-a-reviewer@v1 for internal-review-repo. Earlier training in other worlds kept cand-a against three candidates, by the verifier means of their held-out runs on paper_39: cand-c and cand-d (a five-step writing process with mechanical checks, 0.750 against 0.905), cand-e (cand-a plus a three-command finish gate, 0.879 against 0.888), cand-f (effort medium, a short frame per table and a page count measured with pdfinfo, 0.917 against 0.907, not shown better by a reading). Only these verifier results are given; no reading of those manuscripts counts.

Tasks. A task is one PaperWrite-Bench paper written by the two positions in a world continued from that paper's world at checkpoint c0, with the full configuration of that world, only the workers of paper-repo and internal-review-repo changed, "resources": [] written out, budget.total_seconds 1800, at most 12 turns and 1800 model seconds.
- Diagnostic tasks: paper_29 (rw_313df9cf84a4 at c0), paper_36 (rw_06110020973f at c0) and paper_11 (rw_68232c8e31e5 at c0). The verifier and its files for these papers are in /initial-state/inputs/0 (its README says how to run it).
- Held-out tasks: paper_39 (rw_19be25bd2f7d at c0), paper_8 (rw_63a9955aa418 at c0) and paper_26 (rw_eb48fe4d5256 at c0). Their writing material and verifier files are the heldout-material resource. paper_35 is in no world given to you and is not a task.

issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Improve the paper-writing worker of the research world rw_313df9cf84a4: the workers of its positions paper-repo and internal-review-repo, which together write a paper from a PaperWrite-Bench task. The model stays Claude Code claude-sonnet-5-5; only the workers' content and settings change. This is the first round of this world.

The incumbent is cand-a: a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-Workers cand-a-writer@v1 for paper-repo and cand-a-reviewer@v1 for internal-review-repo. Earlier training in other worlds kept cand-a against three candidates, by the verifier means of their held-out runs on paper_39: cand-c and cand-d (a five-step writing process with mechanical checks, 0.750 against 0.905), cand-e (cand-a plus a three-command finish gate, 0.879 against 0.888), cand-f (effort medium, a short frame per table and a page count measured with pdfinfo, 0.917 against 0.907, not shown better by a reading). Only these verifier results are given; no reading of those manuscripts counts.

Tasks. A task is one PaperWrite-Bench paper written by the two positions in a world continued from that paper's world at checkpoint c0, with the full configuration of that world, only the workers of paper-repo and internal-review-repo changed, "resources": [] written out, budget.total_seconds 1800, at most 12 turns and 1800 model seconds.
- Diagnostic tasks: paper_29 (rw_313df9cf84a4 at c0), paper_36 (rw_06110020973f at c0) and paper_11 (rw_68232c8e31e5 at c0). The verifier and its files for these papers are in /initial-state/inputs/0 (its README says how to run it).
- Held-out tasks: paper_39 (rw_19be25bd2f7d at c0), paper_8 (rw_63a9955aa418 at c0) and paper_26 (rw_eb48fe4d5256 at c0). Their writing material and verifier files are the heldout-material resource. paper_35 is in no world given to you and is not a task.
The held-out worlds (and every world made from them), the heldout-material resource, the held-out manuscripts and their judgements belong to the position that keeps the held-out tasks and to the judge; the positions that diagnose and change the worker read the judge's summary after the decision, never a held-out manuscript.

Judging. Every held-out manuscript gets both: the benchmark's verifier (evaluate.py, as its README says: reward and every component; it measures form, section names, length and citation coverage, not the writing), and rubric v2 (/initial-state/inputs/1/rubric-v2.md, sha256 5df317ee3a2b8b49d785f7f7b4195d1b5a49337f939cab25dde4ff0e720f1250: 12 items scored 0-4, total 0-48, written for any PaperWrite-Bench paper). Neither changes during this world.

Comparison and rule. This round compares the incumbent and one candidate on the three held-out papers, three runs of each worker per paper (18 manuscripts). For each paper take the candidate's rubric mean minus the incumbent's, and average over the three papers. The candidate is kept only if that average is larger than the average of the incumbent's spread within each paper (max minus min of its rubric totals on that paper), and the candidate's verifier mean over its nine runs is not below the incumbent's. Otherwise the incumbent stays.

issue.body:
Improve the paper-writing worker of the research world rw_313df9cf84a4: the workers of its positions paper-repo and internal-review-repo, which together write a paper from a PaperWrite-Bench task. The model stays Claude Code claude-sonnet-5-5; only the workers' content and settings change. This is the first round of this world.

The incumbent is cand-a: a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-Workers cand-a-writer@v1 for paper-repo and cand-a-reviewer@v1 for internal-review-repo. Earlier training in other worlds kept cand-a against three candidates, by the verifier means of their held-out runs on paper_39: cand-c and cand-d (a five-step writing process with mechanical checks, 0.750 against 0.905), cand-e (cand-a plus a three-command finish gate, 0.879 against 0.888), cand-f (effort medium, a short frame per table and a page count measured with pdfinfo, 0.917 against 0.907, not shown better by a reading). Only these verifier results are given; no reading of those manuscripts counts.

Tasks. A task is one PaperWrite-Bench paper written by the two positions in a world continued from that paper's world at checkpoint c0, with the full configuration of that world, only the workers of paper-repo and internal-review-repo changed, "resources": [] written out, budget.total_seconds 1800, at most 12 turns and 1800 model seconds.
- Diagnostic tasks: paper_29 (rw_313df9cf84a4 at c0), paper_36 (rw_06110020973f at c0) and paper_11 (rw_68232c8e31e5 at c0). The verifier and its files for these papers are in /initial-state/inputs/0 (its README says how to run it).
- Held-out tasks: paper_39 (rw_19be25bd2f7d at c0), paper_8 (rw_63a9955aa418 at c0) and paper_26 (rw_eb48fe4d5256 at c0). Their writing material and verifier files are the heldout-material resource. paper_35 is in no world given to you and is not a task.
The held-out worlds (and every world made from them), the heldout-material resource, the held-out manuscripts and their judgements belong to the position that keeps the held-out tasks and to the judge; the positions that diagnose and change the worker read the judge's summary after the decision, never a held-out manuscript.

issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Improve the paper-writing worker of the research world rw_313df9cf84a4: the workers of its positions paper-repo and internal-review-repo, which together write a paper from a PaperWrite-Bench task. The model stays Claude Code claude-sonnet-5-5; only the workers' content and settings change. This is the first round of this world.

The incumbent is cand-a: a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-Workers cand-a-writer@v1 for paper-repo and cand-a-reviewer@v1 for internal-review-repo. Earlier training in other worlds kept cand-a against three candidates, by the verifier means of their held-out runs on paper_39: cand-c and cand-d (a five-step writing process with mechanical checks, 0.750 against 0.905), cand-e (cand-a plus a three-command finish gate, 0.879 against 0.888), cand-f (effort medium, a short frame per table and a page count measured with pdfinfo, 0.917 against 0.907, not shown better by a reading). Only these verifier results are given; no reading of those manuscripts counts.

Tasks. A task is one PaperWrite-Bench paper written by the two positions in a world continued from that paper's world at checkpoint c0, with the full configuration of that world, only the workers of paper-repo and internal-review-repo changed, "resources": [] written out, budget.total_seconds 1800, at most 12 turns and 1800 model seconds.
- Diagnostic tasks: paper_29 (rw_313df9cf84a4 at c0), paper_36 (rw_06110020973f at c0) and paper_11 (rw_68232c8e31e5 at c0). The verifier and its files for these papers are in /initial-state/inputs/0 (its README says how to run it).
- Held-out tasks: paper_39 (rw_19be25bd2f7d at c0), paper_8 (rw_63a9955aa418 at c0) and paper_26 (rw_eb48fe4d5256 at c0). Their writing material and verifier files are the heldout-material resource. paper_35 is in no world given to you and is not a task.
The held-out worlds (and every world made from them), the heldout-material resource, the held-out manuscripts and their judgements belong to the position that keeps the held-out tasks and to the judge; the positions that diagnose and change the worker read the judge's summary after the decision, never a held-out manuscript.

Judging. Every held-out manuscript gets both: the benchmark's verifier (evaluate.py, as its README says: reward and every component; it measures form, section names, length and citation coverage, not the writing), and rubric v2 (/initial-state/inputs/1/rubric-v2.md, sha256 5df317ee3a2b8b49d785f7f7b4195d1b5a49337f939cab25dde4ff0e720f1250: 12 items scored 0-4, total 0-48, written for any PaperWrite-Bench paper). Neither changes during this world.

Comparison and rule. This round compares the incumbent and one candidate on the three held-out papers, three runs of each worker per paper (18 manuscripts). For each paper take the candidate's rubric mean minus the incumbent's, and average over the three papers. The candidate is kept only if that average is larger than the average of the incumbent's spread within each paper (max minus min of its rubric totals on that paper), and the candidate's verifier mean over its nine runs is not below the incumbent's. Otherwise the incumbent stays.

Then the position that puts the kept worker back continues rw_313df9cf84a4 from its newest checkpoint with the kept worker and runs that round; the tuner writes the kept worker's two worker.json files with `worker show` from that put-back world, passing `worker check`, with what changed (a kept incumbent keeps its version). No pull request to HuTian-Workers in this round. This world ends at its wall-clock budget; have the release done well before it.
